props.text: INC-2025-044, sev 2. Impact: payouts were delayed by three hours and some payment captures failed. Timeline: ledger-service v3.4.0 added a parallel payout journal writer. During the daily payout run it opened more connections than the database pool allowed, starving payments-api requests. Root cause: database connection pool exhaustion. Follow-up: load-test payout runs against the pool limit. Res…
